observations.summary: Campaign creation copies the initial brief into each deliverable's production notes. Subsequent campaign brief edits do not refresh those notes.

features.title: Review brief changes before updating production notes
features.requirement: Show which deliverables use an older brief and let the creator preview a new production brief without overwriting manually edited notes.
acceptance: Changing a campaign brief marks affected generated notes as needing review.
Cancelling the preview preserves all existing notes and review states.
Applying a changed production brief resets the affected deliverable's approval checks.
